title: Cover publication-marker uncertainty after production native installation
outcome: Distinguish prepared-reference row persistence failure from marker-stage commit/ack uncertainty in the M5 composition evidence.
acceptance: A composition case drives real marker-stage uncertainty, for example the existing reference_publication_ack_lost hook, after production native installation, and verifies exact reference recovery without reinstall or retarget.
The existing app_state-trigger case is accurately named/documented as prepared-row persistence failure; focused tests pass and review confirms the two cuts are distinct.
